<li>MCP定位，技术栈，架构，项目结构，基础框架搭建，开发部署及常见问题
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre># Loki MCP Server -<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> CLAUDE.md

</span>&gt; Go 实现的 MCP Server，集成 Grafana Loki 日志查询。支持 Claude Desktop / Claude Code /<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Cursor 等客户端通过自然语言查询日志。

</span>---<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

## 一、项目概述

### 定位

将 Grafana Loki 的日志查询能力通过 MCP (Model Context Protocol) 暴露给 AI 助手，运维人员可以用自然语言代替 LogQL 查询日志。

### 技术栈

</span>| 层 | 技术 | 版本 |
|---|------|------|
| 语言 | Go | <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1.24</span>+ |
| MCP SDK | github.com/mark3labs/mcp-go | v0.<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">32.0</span> |
| 日志存储 | Grafana Loki | <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2.9</span>.<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span> |
| 日志采集 | Promtail | <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2.9</span>.<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span> |
| 可视化 | Grafana | latest |
| 容器化 | Docker + Compose | - |<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

### 核心能力（</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">3</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 个 MCP Tool）

</span>| Tool | 用途 | Loki API |
|------|------|----------|
| `loki_query` | 执行 LogQL 查询 | `/loki/api/v1/query_range` |
| `loki_label_names` | 获取所有标签名 | `/loki/api/v1/labels` |
| `loki_label_values` | 获取标签值列表 | `/loki/api/v1/label/{name}/values` |

---<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

## 二、架构设计

### 整体架构

```
┌─────────────────┐      ┌──────────────────┐      ┌──────────────┐
│  AI Client      │      │  Loki MCP Server │      │  Grafana     │
│  (Claude Code</span>/  │─────→│  :<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">8080</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">           │─────→│  Loki        │
│   Desktop</span>/      │ MCP  │                  │ HTTP │  :<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">3100</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">       │
│   Cursor)       │      │  </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">3</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 种传输协议:    │      │              │
└─────────────────┘      │  </span>-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> stdio         │      └──────────────┘
                         │  </span>- SSE (/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">sse)    │
                         │  </span>- HTTP (/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">stream)│
                         │                  │
                         │  </span>/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">healthz (K8s)  │
                         └──────────────────┘
```

### 三种传输协议（同端口共存）

</span>| 协议 | 端点 | 场景 |
|------|------|------|
| stdio | 标准输入输出 | 本地 binary / Docker 集成，Claude Desktop 直接启动进程 |
| SSE | `/sse` + `/mcp` | Server-Sent Events，远程连接（旧协议） |
| Streamable HTTP | `/stream` | 新一代 MCP 远程协议（推荐） |

**设计要点**<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">：通过 `http.ServeMux` 将 SSE 和 Streamable HTTP 注册到同一端口，stdio 作为后台 goroutine 并行运行。

### 项目结构

```
loki</span>-mcp/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
├── cmd</span>/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
│   ├── server</span>/main.go          # 入口：注册 Tool + 启动 <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">3</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 种传输
│   └── client</span>/main.go          # JSON-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">RPC 测试客户端
├── internal</span>/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
│   └── handlers</span>/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
│       ├── loki.go             # 核心：</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">3</span> 个 Tool 的完整实现 (<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">993</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 行)
│       └── loki_test.go        # 单元测试 (</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">261</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 行)
├── pkg</span>/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
│   └── utils</span>/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">logger.go         # 简易日志工具
├── grafana</span>/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
│   └── provisioning</span>/datasources/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">loki.yaml  # Grafana 数据源预配置
├── promtail</span>/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
│   └── config.yml              # 日志采集配置
├── examples</span>/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
│   ├── claude</span>-desktop/         # <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">4</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 种 Claude Desktop 配置示例
│   ├── claude</span>-code-commands/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">   # Slash Command 模板
│   ├── simple</span>-sse-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">client.html  # SSE 测试页面
│   └── sse</span>-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">client.html         # 完整 SSE 客户端
├── docker</span>-compose.yml          # 本地 <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">5</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 服务开发环境
├── Dockerfile                  # 多阶段构建
├── Makefile                    # 构建</span>/测试/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">运行
├── go.mod </span>/ go.<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">sum</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
├── run</span>-mcp-server.<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">sh</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">           # 启动脚本
├── test</span>-loki-query.<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">sh</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">          # 查询测试脚本
├── insert</span>-loki-logs.<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">sh</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">         # 插入测试日志
└── README.md
```

</span>---<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

## 三、从零实现指南

### Phase </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">：基础框架搭建

#### </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1.1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 初始化 Go 项目

```bash
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">mkdir</span> loki-mcp &amp;&amp; cd loki-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">mcp
go mod init github.com</span>/yourname/loki-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">mcp
go get github.com</span>/mark3labs/mcp-go@v0.<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">32.0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
```

#### </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1.2</span> 理解 MCP Server 入口 (`cmd/server/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">main.go`)

核心模式：</span>**创建 Server → 注册 Tool → 启动传输层**<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

```go
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 1. 创建 MCP Server 实例</span>
s :=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> server.NewMCPServer(
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Loki MCP Server</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">0.1.0</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    server.WithResourceCapabilities(</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span>, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">),
    server.WithLogging(),
)

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 2. 注册工具（Tool 定义 + Handler 函数）</span>
lokiQueryTool :=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> handlers.NewLokiQueryTool()
s.AddTool(lokiQueryTool, handlers.HandleLokiQuery)

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 3. 创建传输层</span>
sseServer :=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> server.NewSSEServer(s,
    server.WithSSEEndpoint(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">/sse</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">),
    server.WithMessageEndpoint(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">/mcp</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">),
)
streamableServer :</span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> server.NewStreamableHTTPServer(s)

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 4. 统一路由</span>
mux :=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> http.NewServeMux()
mux.Handle(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">/sse</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, sseServer)
mux.Handle(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">/mcp</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, sseServer)
mux.Handle(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">/stream</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, streamableServer)
mux.HandleFunc(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">/healthz</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, healthHandler)

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 5. 并行启动 HTTP + stdio</span>
go http.ListenAndServe(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">:8080</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, mux)
go server.ServeStdio(s)

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 6. 优雅关闭</span>
stop := <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">make</span>(chan os.Signal, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
signal.Notify(stop, os.Interrupt, syscall.SIGTERM)
</span>&lt;-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">stop
```

</span>**关键设计决策**<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">：
</span>-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 三种传输协议同端口：简化部署，一个端口搞定所有客户端
</span>-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> stdio 后台运行：兼容 Claude Desktop 的进程模式
</span>- `/healthz` 端点：适配 K8s readiness/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">liveness probe

#### </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1.3</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 理解 Tool 定义模式

每个 Tool 由两部分组成：
</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span>. **Tool 定义函数**<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (`NewXxxTool()`) — 声明参数 schema
</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span>. **Handler 函数**<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (`HandleXxx()`) — 处理请求逻辑

```go
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> Tool 定义：声明参数、类型、默认值、描述</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">func NewLokiQueryTool() mcp.Tool {
    return mcp.NewTool(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">loki_query</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
        mcp.WithDescription(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Run a query against Grafana Loki</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">),
        mcp.WithString(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">query</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, mcp.Required(), mcp.Description(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">LogQL query string</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)),
        mcp.WithString(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">url</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, mcp.Description(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Loki server URL</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">), mcp.DefaultString(lokiURL)),
        mcp.WithString(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">start</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, mcp.Description(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Start time (default: 1h ago)</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)),
        mcp.WithNumber(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">limit</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, mcp.Description(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Max entries (default: 100)</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)),
        mcp.WithString(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">format</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, mcp.DefaultString(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">raw</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)),
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> ... 认证参数</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    )
}

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> Handler：提取参数 → 构建请求 → 调用 Loki API → 格式化输出</span>
func HandleLokiQuery(ctx context.Context, request mcp.CallToolRequest) (*<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">mcp.CallToolResult, error) {
    args :</span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> request.GetArguments()
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> ... 处理逻辑</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    return mcp.NewToolResultText(formattedResult), nil
}
```

### Phase </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">：核心逻辑实现

#### </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2.1</span> 请求处理流程 (`internal/handlers/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">loki.go`)

```
参数提取 → 环境变量回退 → 时间解析 → URL构建 → HTTP请求 → 响应解析 → 格式化输出
```

#### </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2.2</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 参数提取模式（带环境变量回退）

每个参数都遵循：</span>**请求参数 &gt; 环境变量 &gt; 默认值**<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 的优先级链

```go
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 统一模式：先看请求参数，再看环境变量</span>
var lokiURL <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> urlArg, ok := args[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">url</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>].(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span>); ok &amp;&amp; urlArg != <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">""</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
    lokiURL </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> urlArg
} </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">else</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
    lokiURL </span>= os.Getenv(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">LOKI_URL</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> lokiURL == <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">""</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
        lokiURL </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">http://localhost:3100</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    }
}
```

环境变量清单：

</span>| 变量 | 用途 | 默认值 |
|------|------|--------|
| `LOKI_URL` | Loki 地址 | `http:<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">localhost:3100` |</span>
| `LOKI_ORG_ID` | 租户 ID | 空 |
| `LOKI_USERNAME` | Basic Auth 用户名 | 空 |
| `LOKI_PASSWORD` | Basic Auth 密码 | 空 |
| `LOKI_TOKEN` | Bearer Token | 空 |
| `PORT` | 服务端口 | `<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">8080</span>` |<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

#### </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2.3</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 时间解析 (`parseTime`)

支持多种输入格式，按顺序尝试：

```go
func parseTime(timeStr </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span>) (<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">time</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">.Time, error) {
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 1. "now" 关键字</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> timeStr == <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">now</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> { return <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">time</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">.Now(), nil }

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 2. 相对时间: "-1h", "-30m"</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> timeStr[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span>] == <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">-</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
        duration, err :</span>= <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">time</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">.ParseDuration(timeStr)
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> err == nil { return <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">time</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">.Now().Add(duration), nil }
    }

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 3. RFC3339: "2024-01-15T10:30:45Z"
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 4. ISO 变体: "2006-01-02T15:04:05", "2006-01-02 15:04:05"
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 5. 纯日期: "2006-01-02"</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">}
```

#### </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2.4</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> URL 构建

智能路径拼接，处理各种 base URL 格式：

```go
func buildLokiQueryURL(baseURL, query </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span>, start, end int64, limit <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span>) (<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, error) {
    u, _ :</span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> url.Parse(baseURL)

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 路径规范化：避免重复拼接</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> !strings.Contains(u.Path, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">loki/api/v1</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">) {
        u.Path </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">/loki/api/v1/query_range</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    }

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 查询参数</span>
    q :=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> u.Query()
    q.Set(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">query</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, query)           <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> LogQL</span>
    q.Set(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">start</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">fmt</span>.Sprintf(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">%d</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, start))  <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> Unix 秒</span>
    q.Set(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">end</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">fmt</span>.Sprintf(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">%d</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, end))
    q.Set(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">limit</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">fmt</span>.Sprintf(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">%d</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, limit))
    u.RawQuery </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> q.Encode()
    return u.String(), nil
}
```

#### </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2.5</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 认证机制

三级认证，优先级：Bearer Token </span>&gt; Basic Auth &gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 无认证

```go
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> token != <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">""</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
    req.Header.Add(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Authorization</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Bearer </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>+<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">token)
} </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">else</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> username != <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">""</span> || password != <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">""</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
    req.SetBasicAuth(username, password)
}

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 多租户隔离（始终添加如果有值）</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> orgID != <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">""</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
    req.Header.Add(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">X-Scope-OrgID</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, orgID)
}
```

#### </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2.6</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 响应数据结构

```go
type LokiResult struct {
    Status </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span>   `json:<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">status</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>`   <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> "success" | "error"</span>
    Data   LokiData `json:<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">data</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">`
    Error  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span>   `json:<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">error,omitempty</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">`
}

type LokiData struct {
    ResultType </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span>      `json:<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">resultType</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>` <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> "streams"</span>
    Result     []LokiEntry `json:<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">result</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">`
}

type LokiEntry struct {
    Stream map[</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span>]<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> `json:<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">stream</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>` <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 标签: {job: "xx", pod: "xx"}</span>
    Values [][]<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span>        `json:<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">values</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>` <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> [[纳秒时间戳, 日志行], ...]</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">}
```

#### </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2.7</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 三种输出格式

</span>| 格式 | 用途 | 示例 |
|------|------|------|
| `raw`（默认） | AI 解析友好，最紧凑 | `<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2024</span>-<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">01</span>-15T10:<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">30</span>:45Z {job=api} Request received` |
| `json` | 程序化处理 | 完整 JSON 结构 |
| `text` | 人类可读 | 编号 Stream + 时间戳日志行 |<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

#### </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2.8</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 已知 Bug 及修复

</span>**时间戳 <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2262</span> 年 Bug**：Loki 返回纳秒时间戳，早期实现使用 `<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">time</span>.Unix(ts, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span>)` 将纳秒当秒处理，导致显示 <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2262</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 年。

修复：`</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">time</span>.Unix(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span>, int64(ts))` — 第一个参数为 <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 秒，第二个参数为纳秒。

### Phase </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">3</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">：Docker 化与本地环境

#### </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">3.1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Dockerfile（多阶段构建）

```dockerfile
# Stage </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">: 编译
FROM golang:</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1.24</span>-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">alpine AS builder
WORKDIR </span>/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">app
COPY go.mod go.</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">sum</span> ./<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
RUN go mod download          # 利用缓存层
COPY . .
RUN CGO_ENABLED</span>=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span> GOOS=linux go build -o loki-mcp-server ./cmd/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">server

# Stage </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">: 运行（最小镜像）
FROM alpine:latest
WORKDIR </span>/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">app
COPY </span>--from=builder /app/loki-mcp-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">server .
EXPOSE </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">8080</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
ENTRYPOINT [</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">./loki-mcp-server</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">]
```

</span>**关键点**<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">：
</span>- `CGO_ENABLED=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">`：静态链接，不依赖 glibc
</span>- 先 COPY go.mod/go.<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">sum</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> → `go mod download`：利用 Docker 层缓存加速构建
</span>-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 最终镜像基于 `alpine:latest`：最小化攻击面

#### </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">3.2</span> Docker Compose（<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">5</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 服务完整环境）

```yaml
services:
  loki</span>-mcp-server:    # MCP Server :<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">8080</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    depends_on:
      loki:
        condition: service_healthy  # 等 Loki 就绪

  loki:               # 日志存储 :</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">3100</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    healthcheck:      # </span>/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">ready 端点检查
      test: [</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">CMD-SHELL</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">wget -q --spider http://localhost:3100/ready || exit 1</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">]

  grafana:            # 可视化 :</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">3000</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    volumes:
      </span>- ./grafana/provisioning:/etc/grafana/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">provisioning  # 预配置数据源

  promtail:           # 日志采集
    volumes:
      </span>- /var/log:/var/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">log                    # 采集宿主机日志
      </span>- /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">docker.sock  # 采集容器日志

  log</span>-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">generator:      # 测试日志生成器
    command: </span>|        # 每 <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">5</span> 秒生成 INFO/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">ERROR 日志
      </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">while</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">do</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">echo</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">INFO: ...</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">sleep</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">5</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">done</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
```

</span>**服务依赖链**：`log-generator → promtail → loki → loki-mcp-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">server`，Grafana 独立。

### Phase </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">4</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">：测试策略

```go
func TestFormatLokiResults_NoYear2262Bug(t </span>*<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">testing.T) {
```

### Phase </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">5</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">：部署与客户端集成

#### </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">5.1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 部署方式选择

</span>| 方式 | 场景 | 命令 |
|------|------|------|
| 本地二进制 | 开发调试 | `<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">make</span> run` |
| Docker 单容器 | 已有 Loki 实例 | `docker run -p <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">8080</span>:<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">8080</span> -e LOKI_URL=... loki-mcp-server` |
| Docker Compose | 完整本地环境 | `docker-compose up --build` |
| K8s Deployment | 生产环境 | 见下方 manifest |
| 远程 URL | 团队共享 | `https:<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">loki-mcp.loki.com/stream` |</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
#### </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">5.2</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> K8s 部署建议

```yaml
apiVersion: apps</span>/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: loki</span>-mcp-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">server
spec:
  replicas: </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">                           # 无状态，可水平扩展
  template:
    spec:
      containers:
      </span>- name: loki-mcp-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">server
        image: loki</span>-mcp-server:v0.<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1.0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">   # 固定版本
        ports:
        </span>- containerPort: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">8080</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">env</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
        </span>-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> name: LOKI_URL
          value: </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">http://loki-gateway.monitoring:3100</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>
        -<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> name: LOKI_TOKEN
          valueFrom:
            secretKeyRef:
              name: loki</span>-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">auth
              key: token
        readinessProbe:
          httpGet:
            path: </span>/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">healthz
            port: </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">8080</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
          periodSeconds: </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">10</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        livenessProbe:
          httpGet:
            path: </span>/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">healthz
            port: </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">8080</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
          periodSeconds: </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">30</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        resources:
          requests:
            cpu: 50m
            memory: 64Mi
          limits:
            cpu: 200m
            memory: 128Mi
```

## 四、开发命令速查

```bash
# 构建
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">make</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> build                  # 编译本地二进制
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">make</span> build-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">linux            # 交叉编译 Linux (amd64)
docker build </span>-t loki-mcp-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">server .  # 构建镜像

# 运行
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">make</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> run                    # 本地运行
docker</span>-compose up --<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">build   # 完整本地环境

# 测试
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">make</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> test                   # 单元测试
go test </span>-race ./<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">...         # 竞态检测
.</span>/test-loki-query.<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">sh</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        # 集成测试
.</span>/insert-loki-logs.<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">sh</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">       # 插入测试数据

# 依赖
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">make</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> deps                   # 下载依赖
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">make</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> tidy                   # 整理 go.mod

# 清理
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">make</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> clean                  # 删除二进制
docker</span>-compose down -<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">v      # 清理容器和数据卷
```

</span>---<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

## 五、代码规范

### Go 规范

</span>- `gofmt` /<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> `goimports` 格式化
</span>- 错误处理：`<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">fmt</span>.Errorf(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">context: %w</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, err)` 包装
</span>-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 环境变量用 `const` 定义名称，避免硬编码字符串
</span>-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> HTTP 客户端必须设置 `Timeout`（当前 30s）
</span>-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 使用 `context.Context` 传递请求上下文

### MCP Tool 开发规范

</span>-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Tool 名称用 `snake_case`（如 `loki_query`）
</span>-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 必填参数用 `mcp.Required()` 标记
</span>-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 每个参数都要有 `mcp.Description()`，包含默认值说明
</span>-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 环境变量回退必须在 Handler 中实现（而非仅 Tool 定义中）
</span>-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 返回 `mcp.NewToolResultText()` 作为标准响应

### 新增 Tool 模板

如果需要添加新工具（如 `loki_series`），遵循以下步骤：

</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span>. 在 `internal/handlers/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">loki.go` 中添加：
   </span>-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> `NewLokiSeriesTool()` — 定义参数
   </span>-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> `HandleLokiSeries()` — 实现逻辑
   </span>-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> `buildLokiSeriesURL()` — URL 构建
   </span>-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> `executeLokiSeriesQuery()` — HTTP 请求
   </span>-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> `formatLokiSeriesResults()` — 格式化输出

</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span>. 在 `cmd/server/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">main.go` 中注册：
   ```go
   seriesTool :</span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> handlers.NewLokiSeriesTool()
   s.AddTool(seriesTool, handlers.HandleLokiSeries)
   ```

</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">3</span>. 在 `internal/handlers/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">loki_test.go` 中添加测试

</span>---<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

## 六、运维关注点

### 可观测性

</span>- `/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">healthz` 端点返回 `ok`，适配 K8s probe
</span>-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 服务本身无状态，无需持久化存储
</span>-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 启动日志输出所有端点地址
</span>- 建议：生产环境添加 Prometheus metrics 端点（`/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">metrics`）

### 安全

</span>-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 认证信息通过环境变量注入，不写入镜像层
</span>-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Bearer Token 优先于 Basic Auth
</span>- 多租户通过 `X-Scope-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">OrgID` 头隔离
</span>-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> HTTP 超时 30s 防止慢查询阻塞

### 扩展方向

</span>| 方向 | 说明 |
|------|------|
| 添加 `/metrics` | Prometheus 指标暴露 |
| 添加 `loki_series` Tool | 查询 series 元数据 |
| 添加 `loki_stats` Tool | 查询 ingester 统计 |
| 提取认证参数公共函数 | 消除 <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">3</span> 个 Handler 中的重复代码 |
| 添加请求日志中间件 | 记录每次 Tool 调用的查询和耗时 |
| 支持 TLS | HTTPS 终止或证书配置 |
| 添加 rate limiting | 防止 AI 频繁查询 |

---<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

```
第 </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 天：跑起来

├── parseTime 多格式时间解析

└── Go 表驱动测试风格

第 </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">5</span> 天：Docker +<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 部署
├── Dockerfile 多阶段构建
├── docker</span>-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">compose.yml 服务编排
├── K8s 部署清单设计
└── 客户端集成配置

第 </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">6</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 天：动手扩展
├── 尝试添加 loki_series Tool
├── 提取认证参数公共函数（消除重复）

```

## 八、常见问题

### 连接失败
</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">. `claude mcp get loki` 检查配置
</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">. 确认网络连通性
</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">3</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">. 检查 HTTPS 证书

### 查询无结果
</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">. 确认 Loki 有对应时间范围的数据
</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">. 多租户场景检查 `org_id`
</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">3</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">. 用 `loki_label_names` 先查可用标签

### Docker 环境问题
</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">. Loki 启动需要时间，等 healthcheck 通过
</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">. Mac 上 Docker 访问宿主机用 `host.docker.internal`
</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">3</span>. `docker-compose down -<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">v` 可清理数据重来

### 时间戳显示异常
</span>- 确认使用 `<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">time</span>.Unix(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span>, int64(ns))` 而非 `<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">time</span>.Unix(ns, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)`
</span>- Loki 返回纳秒时间戳，不是秒</pre>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
</li>
<li>&nbsp;使用测试
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>▗ ▗   ▖ ▖  Claude Code v2.<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1.96</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
           Opus </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">4.6</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (1M context) with medium effort · API Usage Billing
  ▘▘ ▝▝    </span>~/loki-mcp<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
  ⎿ &nbsp;SessionStart:startup hook error

❯ </span>/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">mcp 
  ⎿  MCP </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">dialog</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> dismissed

❯ loki查看所有可用的标签名                                                                                                                                                                                

⏺ loki </span>-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> loki_label_names (MCP)

⏺ Loki 当前可用的标签名：

  ┌────────────────┬─────────────────────────┐
  │      标签      │        常见用途         │
  ├────────────────┼─────────────────────────┤
  │ app            │ 应用名称                │
  ├────────────────┼─────────────────────────┤
  │ broker         │ 消息代理                │
  ├────────────────┼─────────────────────────┤
  │ component      │ 组件标识                │
  ├────────────────┼─────────────────────────┤
  │ container      │ 容器名                  │
  ├────────────────┼─────────────────────────┤
  │ </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">env</span>            │ 环境 (prod/staging/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">dev) │
  ├────────────────┼─────────────────────────┤
  │ filename       │ 日志文件路径            │
  ├────────────────┼─────────────────────────┤
  │ host           │ 主机名                  │
  ├────────────────┼─────────────────────────┤
  │ instance       │ 实例地址                │
  ├────────────────┼─────────────────────────┤
  │ job            │ Prometheus job 名称     │
  ├────────────────┼─────────────────────────┤
  │ namespace      │ K8s 命名空间            │
  ├────────────────┼─────────────────────────┤
  │ node_name      │ K8s 节点名              │
  ├────────────────┼─────────────────────────┤
  │ pod            │ Pod 名称                │
  ├────────────────┼─────────────────────────┤
  │ request_method │ HTTP 请求方法           │
  ├────────────────┼─────────────────────────┤
  │ service_name   │ 服务名称                │
  ├────────────────┼─────────────────────────┤
  │ site           │ 站点标识                │
  ├────────────────┼─────────────────────────┤
  │ status         │ 状态码                  │
  ├────────────────┼─────────────────────────┤
  │ stream         │ stdout</span>/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">stderr           │
  ├────────────────┼─────────────────────────┤
  │ uri            │ 请求路径                │
  └────────────────┴─────────────────────────┘

  ├────────┼───────────────────────────────┼───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤                                                        
  │ P1     │ 检查 userId</span>=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">123456</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 账户健康度 │ 多个 portfolio 同时触发清算，equity 极低，需确认是否需人工干预                                    │                                                          
  ├────────┼───────────────────────────────┼───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤                                                        
  │ P2     │ 排查高频下单源                │ </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">10.19</span>.<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">5.136</span> 上每 <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">5</span> 分钟爆发 <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">158</span> 次 MAX_ORDERS_ERROR，定位是哪个 API client /<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 策略在重复触碰限制   │                                                          
  ├────────┼───────────────────────────────┼───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤                                                          
  │ P3     │ 优化清算限频逻辑              │ cancel all</span>/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">open exceed limit 说明清算过程中的撤单频率控制可能需要调整，避免清算流程被自身限频阻断 │                                                          
  ├────────┼───────────────────────────────┼───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤                                                          
  │ P4     │ 确认 EMS 数据一致性           │ ems not exist 虽然只有 </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 条，但可能代表订单生命周期管理的隐患                                     │
  └────────┴───────────────────────────────┴───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘                                                          
                  
  需要我针对某个具体问题深入排查吗？比如查看 userId</span>=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">123456</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 的更多日志，或者分析下单源的 TraceId 链路。                                                                                                    
                  </span></pre>
</div>

</li>
